test_title: PYST 10: SSC GD - GA & GK (Held on: 22nd November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: gk
question: Who among the following players did NOT win a gold medal at the Alexis Valentine International Boxing Tournament held in Nantes, France 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sumit Sangwan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sumit Sangwan **won a bronze medal in the **81 kg category.**
 
• **Alexis Valentine International Boxing **Tournament was the first sports event to be held after the lockdown.
 
• **Amit Panghal(52 kg), Sanjeet(91 kg) and Ashish Kumar (75 kg)** won gold medals at the tournament.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Amit Panghal** is also a silver medalist at the **2019 AIBA World Boxing Championships.**
 
• Ashish Kumar clinched a **gold medal by defeating his opponent from the USA, Joseph Gerome Hiks.**
 
• India has been involved in **amateur boxing since the 1920s and made its mark in Asia in the 1950s and 60s**.
